question: Which ministry launched the website e-Sahaj that allows organizations/firms/companies/individuals to apply for security clearance from anywhere over the internet?

options.text: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Home Affairs**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Union Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) **has created the **e-Sahaj platform **to make it easier for individuals and private organisations to obtain security clearance for establishing businesses in critical industries.
 
• The platform intends to increase transparency when it comes to granting security clearances to business proposals involving sensitive industries and locations.
 
• Before the administrative ministry issues corporations, bidders, and people with licences, permits, permissions, and contracts, the home ministry is the focal body for giving security clearances in some sensitive areas.
 
• Before approving investment and project proposals in important industries, national security clearance evaluates potential security threats, including economic threats, and provides risk assessments. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
